{"dialogue": "Jen: finally finished that book on the couch
Me: oh the detective one?
Jen: yeah that one
Jen: took me forever lol
Me: did you like it??
Jen: no the ending sucked so bad
Me: nooo really?
Jen: like the killer was just some random neighbor we met once
Me: hate when they do that
Jen: right? no clues or anything
Me: that's so unsatisfying
Jen: i wanted to throw it across the room
Me: did you??
Jen: no my tea was on the coffee table i didn't want to risk it
Me: smart priorities
Jen: lol exactly
Me: what are you having for dinner btw
Jen: just leftover soup, you?
Me: thinking pasta but i'm too lazy to boil water
Jen: that's literally the easiest part
Me: still feels like work rn
Jen: fair, it's sunday evening brain
Me: my cat is back on staring duty
Jen: creepy gremlin is back
Me: yep sitting on the armrest just watching me
Jen: she knows about the pasta indecision
Me: she's judging hard
Jen: as she should
Me: did you end up getting a new umbrella after last time?
Jen: yeah grabbed a cheap black one at lunch that next monday
Me: nice, is it holding up?
Jen: so far, hasn't even rained much since
Me: watch, now that you have one it won't rain
Jen: literally how it works
Me: are you gonna read anything else next or break?
Jen: gonna take a break i think
Jen: still annoyed about that ending
Me: yeah i would be too, such a waste of a good setup
Jen: exactly! the first half was actually good
Me: maybe donate that one and move on
Jen: yeah it's going in the donate pile
Me: soup and trash tv tonight then?
Jen: yep soup then early bed
Me: same, pasta or cereal, we'll see", "writer_note": "Kept the voices casual and lowercase like the September thread and buried the book payoff in evening chatter about dinner, the cat, and the replacement umbrella to feel like real Sunday catch-up with no future plans made."}
